Drone Building Cleaning Solutions

Building facade soft washing and pressure washing.

DRONEWASH+ Drone Building Clenaing—A Smarter, Faster Way to Maintain Your Building

DRONREWASH+ provides nationwide drone-powered exterior cleaning designed for commercial structures that require a deeper, high-pressure restoration without the logistical nightmare of heavy machinery.

​

Our high-pressure jet system allows building envelopes to be cleaned and treated at scale while eliminating the risks of manual labor, removing the need for costly scaffolding, and significantly reducing the carbon footprint compared to traditional power washing methods.

​

Types of surfaces and structures that benefit from drone cleaning:

 

  • Industrial façades and metal-clad warehouses

  • Stucco, brick, and stone commercial exteriors

  • Historic landmarks and delicate architectural features

  • Multi-level parking structures and concrete complexes

  • Steep-pitched roofs and hard-to-reach steeples

Specialized Exterior Cleaning Services

Drone Soft Washing

Uses low-pressure chemical application to eliminate organic growth, moss, and algae from delicate facades without risk of surface damage.

High-Pressure Drone Washing

Delivers targeted, high-pressure cleaning up to 4,000 psi for masonry, concrete, and industrial surfaces to strip away stubborn grime and pollution.

Thermal Hot Water Cleaning

Heated water systems to break down grease, oils, and heavy industrial deposits.

Graffiti Removal

Efficient removal of paint and vandalism from surfaces using a variety of cleaning agents.

Rust Removal

Targets and neutralizes oxidized metallic staining on building envelopes, restoring the original appearance of metal cladding and stone.

Protective Coating Applications

Drone-based application of sealants, water repellents, and anti-graffiti coatings to extend the life of the building exterior.

Recurring Cleaning & Spot Treatments

Scheduled cleaning services and spot cleaning designed to maintain buildings long-term.

Drone Building Cleaning Capabilities

DRONEWASH+ sets the industry standard for drone building cleaning with repeatable, professional cleaning solutions engineered specifically for the complex buildings.

​

Our operations are built on four core pillars of reliability:

​

  • Standardized Safety Systems: Rigorous protocols that exceed industry requirements for high-access work.

  • Purpose-Built Equipment: Proprietary drone technology designed specifically for heavy-duty commercial cleaning.

  • Certified Operators: Every pilot is extensively trained and vetted to ensure consistent quality.

  • Scalable Processes: Streamlined logistics designed to handle every portfolio size and scale.

​

We are not experimenting. We are operating at a national scale.

Get a Drone Cleaning Quote

Maximum Height

At DRONEWASH+, we strictly adhere to FAA regulations, including the 400-foot altitude limit for unmanned aircrafts. Equipped with lightweight payloads, our drones clean mid-rise to high-rise buildings.

 

Our teams are required to comply with all regulatory requirements, ensuring safe, legal, and professional cleaning services every time. 

Chemicals

On buildings, our biodegradable cleaning solutions are safe for the environment and are highly effective on tough stains.

 

For regularly maintained windows, we often don’t need any solution at all—our purified water system does the job, leaving windows spotless and streak-free. Sustainable, efficient, and safe, it’s cleaning reimagined.

Cleaning Speed

Drone window cleaning is up to 80% faster than traditional methods for buildings three stories and higher. By eliminating the need for scaffolding and manual labor, our drones deliver efficient, high-quality cleaning, saving time and reducing disruption.
